source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U20: Distinguish timely signed acknowledgement,qualifying payment and revival of an expired claim

payload.title: A fresh period needs the qualifying act before expiry
payload.core_explanation_md:
The acknowledgement route described in the source requires the relevant liability acknowledgement in writing, signed by the proper party, before the prescribed period expires. The qualifying payment route also depends on the payment, authority, timing and statutory record requirements. A casual unsigned conversation cannot simply be entered as a fresh limitation start.

Do not assume a later letter revives an already expired claim under these provisions. A different legal promise or remedy, if available, needs its own legal basis and evidence. Keep the existing deadline, act date, signer capacity, contents and supporting record together; a new ledger-entry date does not prove a qualifying acknowledgement or payment.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a post-expiry entry automatically restart limitation under the timely-acknowledgement provision?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Timing and all statutory conditions must be met.

payload.stem_md: Staff add an unsigned internal note after expiry and call it the debtor acknowledgement. What is missing?

options.explanation_md: A nickname does not establish the debtor act.

options.text_md: A presumption that every note is signed by the debtor

options.explanation_md: Value does not establish acknowledgement conditions.

options.text_md: The timely qualifying signed act by the proper party
options.explanation_md: An internal late note does not supply those facts.

payload.correct_explanation_md: An internal late note does not supply those facts.

payload.stem_md: A payment is made by a person whose authority to act for the debtor is not established. What should the limitation review examine?

options.text_md: Any payment always has identical legal effect
The payer authority, timing and required evidentiary conditions
options.explanation_md: A transaction amount alone does not prove a fresh period.

options.text_md: Whether the bank uses online statements
options.explanation_md: Statement format does not establish payer authority.

options.text_md: Only whether the payment is a round number
options.explanation_md: Rounding is unrelated to the legal test.

payload.correct_explanation_md: A transaction amount alone does not prove a fresh period.
